literal_source_claim: An independence concept in stability theory.
canonical_claim_candidate: For a complete stable first-order theory, nonforking of tuples over parameter sets defines a ternary independence relation satisfying the standard stable-theory independence calculus, including invariance, finite character, symmetry, transitivity, extension, and local character, with the exact theorem package and hypotheses to be selected from a reviewed primary source.
domain_and_universes: Provisionally a first-order language L, a complete stable L-theory T, a sufficiently saturated ambient model of T, small parameter sets A, B, C, and finite or small tuples a. Exact universe bounds, monster-model convention, and smallness cardinals are open.
quantifiers: first-order language L and complete theory T
ambient model and its saturation/homogeneity data
parameter sets A, B, and C in the ambient model
formulas and complete types used to define dividing and forking
hypotheses: candidate root assumes T is complete and stable
base and parameter sets satisfy source-specific smallness and inclusion conditions
the ambient model satisfies the source-specific saturation/homogeneity conditions
conclusion: Open: a selected, source-exact theorem about the nonforking relation, rather than the mere existence or naming of the concept.

alternate_encodings.target: formula does not fork over A, defined by absence of a finite disjunction of formulas dividing over A
alternate_encodings.relationship: definition-level ingredient, not by itself the candidate independence-calculus root

alternate_encodings.target: tp(a / B) does not fork over A, written a independent from B over A
alternate_encodings.relationship: intended ternary-relation encoding after checked equivalence with the selected type/formula convention

excluded_degenerate_cases: No arbitrary ternary relation may be called forking independence. Stability, completeness, saturation, smallness, tuple arity, algebraic types, empty bases, and equality of parameter sets must follow the reviewed theorem rather than be silently added or removed.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic, choice, compactness, saturation, and cardinal dependencies remain to be audited
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are candidate components; exact imports, target declaration, dependency closure, and axiom profile remain open
computation_profile: noncomputable model-theoretic reasoning expected; no oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source theorem selection, canonical wording, definitions of stability/dividing/forking, universe or monster-model convention, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, profile, or validator change; independent review and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Planned intake only. The repository wording is not a proposition. No exact source theorem, canonical Lean target, source acceptance, proof credit, accepted task state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
